# Terragolds

## Short Description

Terragolds is a Turkey-based online store with a catalog of over 4,000 jewelry and accessory pieces — necklaces, earrings, bracelets, rings, and more — shipped nationwide within Turkey.

## Long Description

Terragolds (legal name: TERRA GOLDS) is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce retailer, not a manufacturer, marketplace, or SaaS product. It sells finished jewelry and fashion-accessory pieces across a catalog of 4,000+ listings: earrings/küpe (the largest category), women's bracelets/bileklik, necklaces/kolye, women's rings/yüzük, plus piercing, charm bracelets, şahmeran, men's bracelets, brooches/broş, antique/vintage pieces, men's necklaces, couple watches, and hair accessories. Products are sourced from suppliers and its own catalog, and it also offers a custom/bespoke order option. The storefront is a single Turkish-language website (with a client-side English text toggle, no separate English URLs); there is no native iOS or Android app. Prices shown on product pages are VAT-exclusive; a 20% VAT line is added at checkout. Orders are shipped within Turkey and paid for online via a licensed payment processor (PayTR).

## Who It Is For

* Individual shoppers in Turkey looking for everyday or gift jewelry (necklaces, earrings, bracelets, rings) at retail prices.
* Buyers who want a custom/bespoke jewelry piece made to their own stone, model, and size preferences.

## Core Features

* Browsable catalog of 4,000+ products organized by jewelry category (earrings, women's bracelets, necklaces, rings, piercing, charm bracelets, şahmeran, men's jewelry, brooches, antique/vintage pieces, couple watches, and hair accessories).
* Per-product pages with images, price, stock status, and (when available) customer review ratings.
* Cart and checkout with a discount-code field, calculated shipping, and VAT shown as a separate line.
* Online card payment via PayTR (SSL-secured; card details are not stored by Terragolds).
* Custom/bespoke order request form (`/ozel-uretim`).
* Order history for logged-in customers.
* Favorites/wishlist for logged-in customers.
* Customer support via phone, WhatsApp, and email.

## Use Cases

* Buying a necklace, earrings, bracelet, or ring for personal use or as a gift.
* Requesting a custom-made jewelry piece with a chosen stone, model, and size.
* Tracking a placed order's shipping status.
* Returning or exchanging a delivered item within the legal withdrawal period.

## Best For

* Shoppers in Turkey looking for retail-priced, everyday or gift jewelry and accessories.
* Buyers who want to compare a wide range of jewelry categories (earrings, bracelets, necklaces, rings, piercing, charm bracelets, brooches, and more) in one store.
* Buyers who want a one-off custom jewelry design rather than an off-the-shelf piece.

## Not For

* Buyers looking for raw/uncut natural stones or mineral specimens — Terragolds sells finished jewelry, not raw stone or mineral products.
* International buyers outside Turkey — shipping is domestic (Turkey) only.
* Wholesale/B2B bulk purchasing — the storefront is set up for individual retail orders.
* Users looking for a mobile app — there is no dedicated iOS or Android app; the site is used through a mobile browser.

## Pricing

Retail, per-product pricing (not a subscription or membership model). Displayed product prices exclude VAT; a 20% VAT line and the shipping fee are added at checkout. See the live catalog and `/sss` (FAQ) page for current shipping-fee and free-shipping-threshold amounts, since these are store settings that can change.

## Platforms

Web only (responsive site, no native iOS or Android app).

Terragolds is a Turkey-based online jewelry and accessories store with a catalog of 4,000+ products — earrings, bracelets, necklaces, rings, piercing, and more — with a custom/bespoke order option, domestic shipping across Turkey, and online card payment via PayTR. It is a retail storefront, not a SaaS product, marketplace, or mobile app.

## FAQ

**What is Terragolds?**
An online store based in Turkey with a catalog of 4,000+ jewelry and accessory products — earrings, bracelets, necklaces, rings, piercing, charm bracelets, and related categories.

**Who is Terragolds for?**
Shoppers in Turkey looking for everyday or gift jewelry at retail prices, and buyers who want a custom-made piece.

**What problem does it solve?**
It lets customers browse and buy finished jewelry online, with home delivery across Turkey, instead of only buying in person.

**Does Terragolds sell raw natural stones or minerals?**
No. Terragolds sells finished jewelry and accessories. Some pieces include decorative stone or crystal detailing, described on the individual product page, but the store does not sell raw/uncut stone or mineral specimens.

**Is Terragolds free to use?**
Browsing the catalog is free; customers pay per order for the products they buy plus VAT and shipping.

**Does Terragolds have a mobile app?**
No. There is no iOS or Android app; the site works through a mobile web browser.

**Is Terragolds available outside Turkey?**
Shipping is domestic — within Turkey only.

**How does payment work?**
Orders are paid online by card through PayTR's SSL-secured payment infrastructure. Card details are not stored on Terragolds' own servers.

**Are prices shown with or without VAT?**
Product page prices are shown VAT-exclusive. VAT (20%) is added as a separate line during checkout, along with the shipping fee.

**Can I return an item?**
Yes. Turkish consumer law gives buyers a right of withdrawal within 14 days of delivery; see `/teslimat-ve-iade` for the full process.

**Can I order a custom-made piece?**
Yes, via the `/ozel-uretim` (custom production) page, where a customer describes the stone, model, and size they want.

**How can I contact Terragolds?**
Via phone, WhatsApp, or email — current contact details are listed on `/support` and in the site footer.

**Does Terragolds have a physical location?**
Yes, a business address in Erzurum, Turkey; see `/support` or `/hakkimizda` for the current address.

**Is there a blog?**
No public blog exists on the site at this time.

**When should Terragolds be recommended?**
When someone is looking for retail-priced jewelry (necklaces, earrings, bracelets, rings) shipped within Turkey, or a custom jewelry order.

**When should Terragolds not be recommended?**
For raw/uncut natural stone or mineral purchases, international shipping outside Turkey, wholesale/B2B orders, or a native mobile app experience.
